modules.title: Parking stopping rail and school bus

nodes.label: Start in park or clutch with brake then check lamps and gauges

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; startup foundation, not high-yield

nodes.label: Back looking through rear window and never back on freeway

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; backing posture foundation

confusable_with.why: Both state the lane-change sequence; sec08-F03 requires mirrors, two-second signal, blind-spot check and safe merge, while sec08-basic-driving-R11 states the same mirrors-first two-second signal and cancel steps

nodes.label: Lane change with mirrors two-second signal blind spot and merge

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield lane-change sequence

confusable_with.why: Both constrain vehicle position; sec08-F04 stays in marked lanes and finishes turns in the corresponding lane, while sec08-F07 stops before the line or crosswalk and leaves wheel-visible gap

nodes.label: Stay in lanes finish turn in entry lane no lane change in intersection

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield lane-use rule

confusable_with.why: Both govern merging; sec08-F05 yields to continuing traffic and bars the solid-white gore area, while sec08-basic-driving-R12 adds yielding plus zipper alternating at a jammed merge

nodes.label: Merge yielding and never cross gore area

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield merge rule

confusable_with.why: Both describe congested merges; sec08-F06 fills both lanes to the point then alternates, while sec08-basic-driving-R12 states the same full-lane use and zipper take-turns rule

nodes.label: Zipper method filling both lanes then alternating

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield zipper rule

nodes.label: Stop before line or crosswalk leaving wheel-visible gap

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; stopping-position foundation

confusable_with.why: Both set hill-park wheel direction; sec08-F08 turns downhill wheels toward the curb with contact, while sec08-F09 turns uphill wheels with a curb away from the curb

nodes.label: Downhill park wheels toward curb with contact then park and brake

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield downhill placement

confusable_with.why: Both set hill-park wheel direction; sec08-F09 turns uphill wheels away from a curb or right without a curb, while sec08-F08 turns downhill wheels toward the curb

nodes.label: Uphill park away from curb or right without curb then park and brake

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield uphill placement

confusable_with.why: Both state curb distance; sec08-F10 caps parking beside a curb at twelve inches with motor stopped and brake set, while sec08-basic-driving-R03 states the same foot-from-curb limit

nodes.label: Park within twelve inches of curb motor stopped brake set locked

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield curb-distance rule

confusable_with.why: Both govern returning after a pass; sec08-F11 returns no less than two hundred feet from oncoming traffic without leaving the roadway, while sec08-basic-driving-R05 requires the same two-hundred-foot clearance

nodes.label: Pass left and return clear of oncoming by two hundred feet

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield passing rule

confusable_with.why: Both bar snowplow passes; sec08-F12 bars passing beside a deployed blade or echelon formation, while sec08-basic-driving-R06 bars the blade side and any pass of three-plow echelon

nodes.label: Never-pass cases including curves intersections rails and snowplows

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield prohibition list

nodes.label: Signal two seconds before turns and lane changes and at curbs

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; signaling foundation

nodes.label: Hands outside wheel fingers not palms steer toward travel path

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; steering foundation

confusable_with.why: Both state the rail-stop window; sec08-F15 stops more than fifteen and not more than fifty feet from the nearest rail, while sec08-basic-driving-R08 states the same fifteen-to-fifty-foot halt

nodes.label: Rail stop fifteen to fifty feet from nearest rail until gate raised

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield rail window

confusable_with.why: Both state school-bus stops by roadway; sec08-F16 stops both directions on two-lane and undivided four-lane but only behind on divided and five-lane roads, while sec08-basic-driving-R07 states the same two-lane and divided distinction

nodes.label: School-bus stop rules by two-lane divided and five-lane roadway

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield bus trap

confusable_with.why: Both limit U-turns; sec08-F17 bars U-turns under five-hundred-foot visibility plus tracks crossings and freeways, while sec08-basic-driving-R10 bars the same short-sight and track and freeway cases

nodes.label: Never U-turn under five hundred feet visibility or on tracks freeway

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield U-turn limits

confusable_with.why: Both set hill-park direction; sec08-basic-driving-R01 rolls downhill toward and uphill with curb away, while sec08-basic-driving-R02 steers uphill without a curb toward the road edge

nodes.label: Hill wheels toward curb downhill and away uphill with curb

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield wheel pair

confusable_with.why: Both set hill-park direction; sec08-basic-driving-R02 steers uphill without a curb toward the edge, while sec08-basic-driving-R01 rolls downhill toward and uphill with curb away

nodes.label: Uphill without curb steer toward road edge

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield no-curb exception

confusable_with.why: Both state curb distance; sec08-basic-driving-R03 keeps the back wheel within a foot of the curb, while sec08-F10 caps parking beside a curb at twelve inches

nodes.label: Keep back wheel within a foot of curb when parked

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield curb distance

confusable_with.why: Both govern parking placement; sec08-basic-driving-R04 bars parking near hydrants crosswalks beacons and rails, while sec08-basic-driving-R03 states the within-a-foot curb finish

nodes.label: No parking near hydrant crosswalk beacon signal or rail

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield prohibition distances

confusable_with.why: Both require pass-return clearance; sec08-basic-driving-R05 requires two hundred feet clear before moving right, while sec08-F11 returns no less than two hundred feet from oncoming

nodes.label: Return after pass only when two hundred feet clear

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield return distance

confusable_with.why: Both bar snowplow passes; sec08-basic-driving-R06 bars the blade side and any pass of echelon plows, while sec08-F12 bars passing beside a deployed blade or echelon

nodes.label: Do not pass on blade side or any echelon snowplows

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield plow exception

confusable_with.why: Both state school-bus stops by roadway; sec08-basic-driving-R07 halts both directions on two-lane and undivided four-lane but only same-direction on divided and five-lane roads, while sec08-F16 states the same divided and center-lane distinction

nodes.label: Bus red lamps stop both ways or only behind by roadway type

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield bus distinction

confusable_with.why: Both state the rail-stop window; sec08-basic-driving-R08 halts farther than fifteen but no farther than fifty feet from the rail, while sec08-F15 stops more than fifteen but not more than fifty feet

nodes.label: Halt fifteen to fifty feet from nearest rail at controlled crossing

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield rail halt

confusable_with.why: Both govern turnarounds; sec08-basic-driving-R09 contrasts forward driveway-first and reverse drive-past two-point turns, while sec08-basic-driving-R10 limits three-point turns to narrow two-lane roads

nodes.label: Forward versus reverse two-point turn driveway use

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield turnaround pair

confusable_with.why: Both govern turnarounds; sec08-basic-driving-R10 limits three-point to narrow two-lane and bars short-sight U-turns, while sec08-basic-driving-R09 defines forward and reverse two-point turns

nodes.label: Three-point only on narrow two-lane and U-turn bans

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; high-yield turnaround limits

nodes.label: Lane change mirrors signal blind spot cancel after merge

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; lane-change restatement

nodes.label: Yield at merge avoid gore use zipper at jam

pedagogic_emphasis.basis: Authored product policy; merge restatement
